purpose: Signing in with an existing account
question: Which account should people be able to sign in with?

choices.label: None — email and password only
choices.hint: The product keeps its own accounts and asks nothing of anyone else.

choices.label: Google
choices.hint: The widest reach almost everywhere. A Google Cloud project with an OAuth client; free.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.hint: Google Cloud console → APIs & Services → Credentials → your OAuth 2.0 Client ID. It ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com.

fields.label: Client secret
fields.hint: The same panel, beside the client id. It starts with GOCSPX-.

fields.label: Redirect URI
fields.hint: Where Google sends people back. This exact string must also be listed under 'Authorised redirect URIs', or sign-in is refused.

choices.label: GitHub
choices.hint: For anything developers use. Note that a GitHub account may have no public email, so plan for that.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.hint: GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps → your app.

fields.label: Client secret
fields.hint: The same page. It is shown once, when you generate it.

fields.label: Callback URL
fields.hint: The 'Authorization callback URL' on the same page. It must match exactly.

choices.label: Facebook
choices.hint: Reach outside the developer world, especially on mobile. The app needs review before it leaves test mode.

fields.label: Redirect URI
fields.hint: Listed under Facebook Login → Settings → Valid OAuth Redirect URIs.

choices.label: Microsoft
choices.hint: Work and school accounts through Entra ID, plus personal Microsoft accounts. What a company intranet expects.

fields.label: Application (client) ID
fields.hint: Entra admin centre → App registrations → your app → Overview.

fields.label: Client secret
fields.hint: Certificates & secrets → Client secrets. The value is shown once.

fields.label: Directory (tenant) ID
fields.hint: Your tenant id for one organisation, or 'common' to accept any account.

fields.label: Redirect URI
fields.hint: Authentication → Redirect URIs, registered as a Web platform.
